choice_prompt:4:1910320001.text: The Coral Sprout's back to life... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a miracle worker!
choice_prompt:4:1910320001.source_cn: 子瑚恢复了……<style=stress><player_name></style>，你是怎么做到的，好厉害！
choice_prompt:4:1910320001.male: The Coral Sprout's back to life... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a miracle worker!
choice_prompt:4:1910320001.female: The Coral Sprout's back to life... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a miracle worker!

say:5:1910320002:1.text: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?
say:5:1910320002:1.source_cn: 这枝子瑚的大部分能量都逸散了，让它恢复原状一定要消耗很...
say:5:1910320002:1.male: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?
say:5:1910320002:1.female: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?

choice_prompt:6:1910320002.text: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?
choice_prompt:6:1910320002.source_cn: 这枝子瑚的大部分能量都逸散了，让它恢复原状一定要消耗很多能量……你有没有哪里不舒服？
choice_prompt:6:1910320002.male: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?
choice_prompt:6:1910320002.female: That must've taken a lot out of you... Are you feeling okay?

say:7:1910320003:1.text: Too bad my Waterstrider is broken! Otherwise, I could whisk him there in just minutes!
say:7:1910320003:1.source_cn: 要是水行器没坏，咱就能带着<male>他</male>...
say:7:1910320003:1.male: Too bad my Waterstrider is broken! Otherwise, I could whisk him there in just minutes!
say:7:1910320003:1.female: Too bad my Waterstrider is broken! Otherwise, I could whisk her there in just minutes!

say:8:1910320004:1.text: Of all times, it had to break down now... Hey, don't get me wrong! I can fix it. I just don't have the right materials!
say:8:1910320004:1.source_cn: 偏偏在这个时候……喂，咱不是说咱手艺不行，是没有合适的...

choice_prompt:9:1910320004.text: Of all times, it had to break down now... Hey, don't get me wrong! I can fix it. I just don't have the right materials!
choice_prompt:9:1910320004.source_cn: 偏偏在这个时候……喂，咱不是说咱手艺不行，是没有合适的材料……

say:10:1910320005:1.text: Ugh... Spare me the sappy talk! You're making my skin crawl!
say:10:1910320005:1.source_cn: 啧……别说这些肉麻话，听得咱全身起疙瘩。

say:11:1910320006:1.text: I just want to pitch in, you know... I can't stand doing nothing.
say:11:1910320006:1.source_cn: 咱也想帮忙的，在旁边干看着，啥都做不了，真是难受死了。

say:12:1910320008:1.text: Same here! I want to do my part to defend my home!
say:12:1910320008:1.source_cn: 我也一样，这里是我的家，我也想用自己的力量保护它！

say:13:1910320009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you teach me that spell later? I want to help out if the last Coral Sprout needs more energy.
say:13:1910320009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you teach me that spell later? I want to help out if the last Coral Sprout needs more energy.
say:13:1910320009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you teach me that spell later? I want to help out if the last Coral Sprout needs more energy.

say:14:1910320010:1.text: If there are any more missing pieces, I'll pick them up. I can't just sit back while everyone works their tails off.
say:14:1910320010:1.source_cn: 还有，再有碎片就让咱来捡。咱可不是那种看别人受苦受累，...

choice_prompt:15:1910320010.text: If there are any more missing pieces, I'll pick them up. I can't just sit back while everyone works their tails off.
choice_prompt:15:1910320010.source_cn: 还有，再有碎片就让咱来捡。咱可不是那种看别人受苦受累，自己袖手旁观的人。

say:17:1910320012:1.text: Can't say for sure until we've seen it... So, where's the last one?
say:17:1910320012:1.source_cn: 得看到实物才能知道……所以，剩下那枝珊瑚在哪儿？

say:18:1910320013:1.text: It's <style="highlight">east</style> of Coralia, a little off the beaten path. I'll get us there!

choice:15:0:1.text: Who knows? Maybe the last one won't need fixing.
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 乐观点，说不定那枝子瑚不需要修复
choice:15:0:1.male: Who knows? Maybe the last one won't need fixing.
choice:15:0:1.female: Who knows? Maybe the last one won't need fixing.

say:20:1910320007:1.text: ... I just want to pitch in! I've got too much pride to stand around looking useless!
say:20:1910320007:1.source_cn: ……咱也想帮忙的！只干看着，啥都不做，那可太没面子了。

choice:9:1:2.text: Aww, look at you showing your softer side!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 没想到你也会这么坦诚地表达善意呀？
choice:9:1:2.male: Aww, look at you showing your softer side!
choice:9:1:2.female: Aww, look at you showing your softer side!

choice:6:0:1.text: I'm fine. It was no big deal.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 没事，这点程度还不算什么
choice:6:0:1.male: I'm fine. It was no big deal.
choice:6:0:1.female: I'm fine. It was no big deal.

choice:6:1:2.text: Let's head to the next Coral Sprout.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 先去修复下一处子瑚吧
choice:6:1:2.male: Let's head to the next Coral Sprout.
choice:6:1:2.female: Let's head to the next Coral Sprout.

choice:4:0:1.text: I used magic to replenish its energy.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 用魔法为子瑚注入能量
choice:4:0:1.male: I used magic to replenish its energy.
choice:4:0:1.female: I used magic to replenish its energy.

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 用魔力填补那些已经逸散的能量
